targets.rawSql:
select
$__timeGroup(session_end,$interval) as 'time',
sum(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is not NULL or json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then 1 end) as 'normal disabled',
sum(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is NULL and json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is NULL then 1 end) as 'instant rotation',
avg(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is not NULL or json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then duration_ms/3600000 end) as 'Average duration'
from stats_accounts
where
$__timeFilter(session_end)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

select
$__timeGroup(session_end,$interval) as 'time',
sum(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is not NULL or json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then 1 end) as 'normal disabled',
sum(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is NULL and json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is NULL then 1 end) as 'instant rotation',
avg(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is not NULL or json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then duration_ms/3600000 end) as 'Average duration'
from stats_accounts
where
$__timeFilter(session_end)

select
$__timeGroup(session_end,$interval) as 'time',
case when reason_for_session_end like 'ErrGo failed to detect lineup for invasion%' then 'ErrGo failed to detect lineup for invasion' else reason_for_session_end end as 'reason_end',
count(reason_for_session_end) as '.'
from stats_accounts
where
$__timeFilter(session_end)
GROUP BY 1,reason_end
ORDER BY 1

select
$__timeGroup(session_end,$interval) as 'time',
sum(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then 1 end) as 'normal disabled',
sum(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is NULL then 1 end) as 'instant rotation',
avg(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is not NULL then json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') end) as 'Average encounters',
avg(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') end) as 'Average gmo',
avg(case when json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL then duration_ms/3600000 end) as 'Average duration'
from stats_accounts
where
$__timeFilter(session_end) and
mode in ('PokemonMode','QuestMode')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

select
$__timeGroup(session_end,$interval) as 'time',
case
  when reason_for_session_end like 'ErrGo failed to detect lineup for invasion%' then 'ErrGo failed to detect lineup for invasion' 
  when reason_for_session_end='ErrDisabled' and (json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is not NULL or json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is not NULL) then 'ErrDisabled'
  when reason_for_session_end='ErrDisabled' and (json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_ENCOUNTER') is NULL and json_extract(counts, '$.METHOD_GET_MAP_OBJECTS') is NULL) then 'instantRotation (rpc18?)'
  else reason_for_session_end
end as 'reason_end',
count(reason_for_session_end) as '.'
from stats_accounts
where
$__timeFilter(session_end) and mode in ($mode)
GROUP BY 1,reason_end
ORDER BY 1
